description: Labelled team-chat messages for the live routing eval (evals/routing.live.test.ts). Each message names who should answer: lead, dev, finance, marketing, or everyone (the classifier's __everyone__). `expect` may list several acceptable answers.

lead.name: Budi
lead.role: Lead PM — owns the roadmap, priorities, deadlines and client coordination

dev.name: Rizky
dev.role: Developer — builds and fixes the web app, APIs, deployments and integrations

finance.name: Sari
finance.role: Finance — invoices, payments, budgets, tax and expense reports

marketing.name: Dewi
marketing.role: Marketing — campaigns, social media, content, SEO and the newsletter
